report.summary: Unit U011 at cycle 147 triggered a high anomaly score (0.920). Sensor data shows a notable rise in spindle vibration (+17%) and a modest temperature increase, while coolant parameters remain stable. These patterns align with early spindle bearing wear symptoms described in SOP-M-101. Comparable historical ticket T1040 documents bearing wear with similar vibration trends. RUL estimate suggests 87 cycles remaining, placing the unit in a monitoring band. Recommend scheduling a bearing inspection per SOP-M-101 to confirm and address potential wear before escalation.
